end.summary: Practised naming cube, cuboid, cylinder, cone and sphere in toys and objects.
end.parentNote: Aditya practised identifying solids by looking at their faces and linking shapes to familiar objects. They correctly explained that a cylinder has two flat faces and a cone has one, and chose a cylinder and cone for a rocket using their features. They mixed up cuboid and cube once and continued to think turning a cone changes its name; this was not corrected by the last turn. At home, ask them to check whether all faces are equal squares before calling a box a cube, and turn objects around while keeping the same shape name.
